title.fr: Transactions, index et migrations : imposer et tester un invariant

completeness.evidence: Foundations repaired; advanced practice explicitly listed.

educationalDepth.evidence: Progresses from business invariant to transaction machinery and operational limits.

beginnerAccessibility.evidence: Names SQL prerequisites, explains DO/DECLARE/INTO, supplies schema and seed data.

accuracy.evidence: Reservation, rollback, constraints and migration execute; concurrency mechanism checked against PostgreSQL docs, not a two-connection test.

codeExamples.evidence: Four examples and complete lab execute in local PGlite; annotations cover each code line.

practicalExercises.evidence: Five sequenced tasks, including deliberate bug reproduction and plan interpretation.

detailedSolutions.evidence: Full SQL plus task-specific reasoning; variable query plans are not represented as fixed results.

realWorldRelevance.evidence: Reservation invariant and migration deployment tradeoffs; one-item schema clearly distinguished from production checkout.

commonMistakes.evidence: Zero rows, aborted transaction, connection-scoped tables, unfounded index expectations.

debuggingGuidance.evidence: First-error diagnosis, ROLLBACK recovery, state assertions and EXPLAIN comparison.

findings: Corrected: the original unconditional INSERT could follow a zero-row UPDATE. ROW_COUNT now raises before insertion.
Corrected: the lab now creates isolated temporary tables and deterministic fixtures.
Expanded: transaction state, constraints, PL/pgSQL, conditional concurrency, ACID, index plans, write costs, backfills and expand/contract.
Corrected: quiz answers now distinguish explicit scenarios and explain every option.
Corrected: the validation command executes the chapter SQL rather than only checking JSON structure.
missingAdvanced: Savepoint recovery needs an additional executable exercise.
Independent-connection concurrency and deadlock/retry behavior need tests against full PostgreSQL.
Multi-product reservations and idempotent checkout need a separate complete implementation.
Large-table backfill and failed concurrent-index recovery need realistic migration rehearsal.
review.nextAction: Add the listed advanced practice and independent PostgreSQL concurrency validation; do not mark the whole topic complete.

Four annotated examples: schema, guarded reservation, index comparison, migration.
Five exercise tasks and full baseline solution with per-task reasoning.
Four symptom/cause/repair cases; three revised comprehension questions.
validation: 11 SQL chapter tests passed with local PGlite.
